name: cetylpyridinium
purpose: Directions Use up to 4 times daily or as directed by a dentist or doctor. Adults and children 3 years and older: rinse mouth with 1/2 Tbsp. for approx. one minute. Instruct to expectorate. Children under 3 years of age: consult a dentist or doctor.
otcwarn: Warnings Stop use and ask a doctor if: Sore mouth symptoms do not improve in 7 days. Swelling, rash or fever develops. Irritation, pain or redness persists or worsens.
